scope: Add an additive report for the existing raw SAB wireframe projection so callers can distinguish unresolved projected fields and see that body placement, unit scaling, and B-rep validation were not performed.

implementation.api: Added DRW_AcisCoordinateSpace::RawRecordValues, DRW_AcisProjectionReport, and drw_extractAcisWireframeWithReport. Existing DRW_AcisBrep layout and legacy extractor signatures are unchanged.
reportFields: edges without both endpoints or without the projected curve flag
faces without the projected surface flag
explicit false values for body root selection, body transforms, source-unit scaling, and B-rep validity checking
tests: generated synthetic graph confirms raw-record coordinate labeling and unresolved-surface count
wrong-type point reference remains a successful partial inventory but is explicitly counted as an unresolved vertex and edge endpoint pair
non-finite geometry rejects the report operation and resets both report and projected output

evidenceBoundary.limitations: The report describes only fields surfaced by the legacy global record inventory. It does not identify or traverse a rooted body, classify zero-inbound records as semantic orphans, apply body/WCS transforms or source units, establish closed topology, or validate a B-rep. A true return means the bounded legacy projection completed, not that the model is semantically complete.

worktree: The repository worktree is broadly dirty; this slice remains uncommitted and no unrelated paths were staged.
